title: Android 15 OneUI 7 : Lost last line of widget
body:
My Samsung S21 FE 5G phone updated to Android 15 and OneUI 7.0. All seems to be working ok excrpt that I "lost" the last line of the AAPS widget.

![Screenshot_20250527_173243_One UI Home.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b2992f05-6a09-474c-a1c8-305429b86db5)

Deleting the widget and putting it back in place doesn't change the problem.

comments.body: You have not enough place for the widget, that´s all. Try to place it to a blank page and it will be OK.
I know that of ciurse. But, in Android 14 and OneUI 6.0, in that same place, everything was visible.
Samsung has changed the grid on the screen, so you now have to add one more row to the widget.
